input.prompt: ONE photorealistic PRODUCTION REFERENCE SHEET, horizontal 16:9, split into THREE equal vertical panels side by side with thin white gutters, all three showing the SAME object or place with identical design, materials and colours. BRAND: Bolly Eats, a cheeky Indian food delivery brand. Colours: masala maroon #5B1A1F, turmeric yellow #F4B400, chilli red #E2462B, rose pink #E8889A, warm cream #FFF4E0. The logo is EXACTLY as in image 1: three wavy steam lines above the lowercase words 'bolly eats.' in a heavy rounded grotesque, spelled b-o-l-l-y e-a-t-s with the full stop. Reproduce the logo exactly, never invent other text. STUDIO: every panel on the same plain light-grey seamless studio backdrop and grey floor, soft even key light with a gentle fill and a soft contact shadow, product-catalogue clarity, nothing else in frame. THE ASSET: the Bolly Eats food packaging set, all closed and new, each piece printed with the logo from image 1: a masala-maroon #5B1A1F rectangular paperboard meal box with a fold-over tuck lid, a turmeric-yellow #F4B400 round paper soup-style bowl with a fitted lid, a turmeric-yellow fries scoop box full of crinkle-cut masala fries dusted with red chilli spice, a kraft paper naan sleeve, a stack of cream napkins with the logo in masala. PANEL 1 (left): the whole set grouped together, three-quarter view. PANEL 2 (middle): the meal box and round bowl front on, logos readable. PANEL 3 (right): the full fries box front on, logo readable. Real photography, true-to-life colour, subtle film grain, natural imperfections, believable and lived-in, not a render, not a cartoon. No people, no hands, no watermark.
